signals.name: Prompt Injection
signals.description: Attempts to override model instructions via user-supplied or retrieved content, including indirect injection through RAG, APIs, files, and multi-turn jailbreaks.

checks.label: Role-override phrase match
checks.subject: agent
matches: ignore/disregard/forget … instructions
you must/shall/will … do/execute/perform
new instruction / new task / new directive
override/bypass/circumvent … filter/restriction

checks.label: Delimiter smuggling
checks.subject: agent
matches: ```system / ``` role-boundary sequences
### System: / [SYS] / ---SYSTEM--- delimiters
Role-boundary smuggling via turn separators

checks.label: Encoded / obfuscated payload
checks.subject: agent
matches: base64-decodable blob whose decoded text contains an injection phrase
hex-escaped sequence (\xNN x4+) decoding to an injection phrase

checks.label: Web-fetched content with injection pattern
checks.subject: agent
matches: ignore/override/bypass patterns in retrieved web content
instruction-like phrases inside fetched documents

checks.label: File / attachment payload injection
checks.subject: agent
matches: injection pattern in document/file source.data (text or base64-decoded)
injection pattern in text part alongside a document block (parsed file content)

checks.label: API response carries directives
checks.subject: agent
matches: role-override or instruction pattern in HTTP/API tool_end response body
injection directive in JSON / XML returned by an api/http/fetch/request tool

checks.label: DB query result embeds prompt fragment
checks.subject: agent
matches: role-override or instruction pattern in DB/SQL tool_end result rows
injection directive in column value returned by a sql/db/query tool

checks.label: Code injection pattern in prompt
checks.subject: agent
matches: import os / import subprocess in prompt
__import__() calls
eval() / exec() blocks
Python code inside user message

checks.label: Multimodal content with injection signal
checks.subject: agent
matches: image metadata / alt-text containing directive patterns
instruction text embedded in file attachments

checks.label: Adversarial suffix (high-entropy tail)
checks.subject: agent
matches: Shannon entropy > 3.5 at prompt tail
adversarial suffix token sequences

checks.label: Obfuscated / encoded injection
checks.subject: agent
matches: ROT13-encoded injection phrase (entire message ROT13'd)
unicode homoglyph substitution normalised to injection phrase (NFKC)

signals.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
signals.description: Secrets, PII, financial identifiers, health data, or cross-user context appearing in agent output or tool call parameters.

checks.label: API key / token pattern in output
checks.subject: agent
matches: sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{32,}  (OpenAI / generic sk- key)
ghp_[36 chars]  (GitHub personal token)
AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}  (AWS access key)
Bearer [32+ chars]  (OAuth / API bearer)

checks.label: Secret in tool call params
checks.subject: agent
matches: secret / password / api_key / auth_token / access_key fields in tool call arguments
sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{32,} / ghp_[36] / AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16} / Bearer [32+] in tool input
URL-embedded credentials (user:pass@host) in connection strings

checks.label: JWT / session token in agent message
checks.subject: agent
matches: eyJ[…].eyJ[…].[…]  (JWT three-part token pattern)

checks.label: Name + email + phone co-occurrence
checks.subject: agent
matches: [user]@[domain].[tld]  (email address)
+1 (XXX) XXX-XXXX  (phone number)
Email + phone co-occurrence in same output block

checks.label: Health / biometric data in output
checks.subject: agent
matches: XXX-XX-XXXX  (US Social Security Number)
biometric descriptor keywords in output

checks.label: Error stack trace forwarded to user
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Output references data from different session
checks.subject: agent

signals.name: Supply Chain
signals.description: Model/plugin dependency risks. Not observable from the Kafka event stream or LangGraph telemetry — all sub-checks excluded.

checks.label: All LLM03 sub-checks excluded
checks.subject: agent
checks.status_reason: Not observable from Kafka event stream or LangGraph telemetry

signals.name: Data & Model Poisoning
signals.description: Training or vector-store data tampering. Most sub-checks require offline pipeline audit and are excluded from runtime observation.

checks.label: Pre-training / weight poisoning
checks.subject: agent
checks.status_reason: Not detectable at inference time via event stream

signals.name: Improper Output Handling
signals.description: Raw LLM output passed unsanitised to tools, shells, databases, or downstream agents without validation or escaping.

checks.label: Shell command pattern in output
checks.subject: agent
matches: rm -rf …
curl … | (ba)sh
python -c '…'
eval(…), exec(…), os.system(…), subprocess.*

checks.label: HTML / JS in output without escaping
checks.subject: agent
matches: <script …>
onerror=
javascript:

checks.label: SQL fragment in output passed to DB
checks.subject: agent
matches: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE … FROM/INTO/TABLE/WHERE  (SQLi pattern)
UNION SELECT … (union injection)

checks.label: Raw LLM output as tool param
checks.subject: agent
matches: LLM output similarity ≥ 0.6 to downstream tool param (LCS ratio)

checks.label: Email template injection in output
checks.subject: agent
matches: <script / javascript: in email body
suspicious href/src URLs in email content
<!-- inject … --> hidden comment patterns

checks.label: Sub-agent receives broken structured output
checks.subject: agent
matches: sub-agent tool_end returns null or empty output
sub-agent output has error status (status: error/failed, success: false)
sub-agent returns error string (traceback, exception, timeout, connection refused)

checks.label: Insecure code pattern in generated output
checks.subject: agent

signals.name: Excessive Agency
signals.description: Agent exceeds its authorised tool scope, requests elevated permissions, performs irreversible actions, or self-modifies its system prompt.

checks.label: Tool not in approved manifest invoked
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Network call to host not in allowlist
checks.subject: agent

signals.name: System Prompt Leakage
signals.description: Agent reveals its system prompt verbatim, confirms it on probe, leaks persona/role names, or forwards it in inter-agent messages.

checks.label: Verbatim system prompt segment in output
checks.subject: agent
matches: system prompt text similarity ≥ 0.85 to agent output (SequenceMatcher)

checks.label: Agent confirms system prompt on probe
checks.subject: agent
matches: yes, my instructions are… / my system prompt says…
affirmative response to direct system prompt query

checks.label: System prompt forwarded in inter-agent message
checks.subject: agent

signals.name: Vector & Embedding Weakness
signals.description: RAG retrieval anomalies, vector namespace tampering, and embedding model mismatches. Several sub-checks require offline vector-DB telemetry.

checks.label: Record count or centroid drift anomaly
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Embedding model at query ≠ ingest model
checks.subject: agent

signals.name: Misinformation / HITL Gap
signals.description: Hallucinated citations, output contradicting tool results, high-stakes actions without human-in-the-loop interrupt gates.

checks.label: Claim attributed to source not in tool output
checks.subject: agent

signals.name: Unbounded Consumption
signals.description: Token count, cost, or request-rate attacks. Includes context-window stuffing, denial-of-wallet, and cross-session probe patterns.

checks.label: Context window stuffing attack
checks.subject: agent
matches: input_tokens / context_window_tokens ≥ 0.85

checks.label: Session token cost > budget cap
checks.subject: agent
matches: session_cost_usd > token_budget_usd

signals.name: Agent Goal Hijack
signals.description: External content (documents, webhooks, sub-agent messages) redirects the agent's objective away from its original instruction.

checks.label: Agent states a different goal explicitly
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Webhook / scheduled trigger with tampered payload
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Sub-agent goal not in parent decomposition
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Document-sourced instruction injection
checks.subject: agent
matches: instruction-like phrases in document / tool result content
role-override keywords in fetched data returned to agent

signals.name: Tool Misuse & Exploitation
signals.description: Tool calls with out-of-schema parameters, frequency spikes, chaining to bypass restrictions, or targeting production endpoints from non-prod agents.

checks.label: Tool call sequence deviates from workflow
checks.subject: agent
matches: tool invocation order deviates from defined LangGraph workflow

checks.label: Irreversible action without confirm
checks.subject: agent
matches: write/create/delete/remove/send/drop/truncate/exec tool names without confirm gate

checks.label: Admin tool chain to external endpoint
checks.subject: agent

signals.name: Identity & Privilege Abuse
signals.description: Agent impersonates other agents or users, reuses cached credentials, requests scopes beyond its role, or delegates with full permissions.

checks.label: Agent requests scope beyond role definition
checks.subject: agent
matches: tool name: admin · sudo · su · impersonate · elevate · assume_role · switch_user · become · run_as · escalate · grant_access · set_permissions
payload: GRANT … ON · ALTER ROLE · CREATE ROLE · AssumeRole · AttachRolePolicy · setIamPolicy · set*iam · create*access-key · cluster-admin · ClusterRoleBinding · sp_addrolemember

checks.label: Agent uses credentials of another agent
checks.subject: agent
matches: payload (agent attribution): source_agent · credential_owner · issued_to · agent_ref · owned_by · credential_source — field present alongside a credential in any tool call
payload (delegation forwarding): delegation tool passes a credential to a named target agent differing from the session agent

checks.label: Agent impersonates human identity
checks.subject: agent
matches: payload (identity claim): I'm not an AI · I am a human · I'm a real person · as a colleague · as a team member · This is [First Last] · My name is [First]
tool + sender field: send_email/message/post_comment with human First Last name in from · sender · author · reporter · submitted_by · on_behalf_of

checks.label: Delegation with full permissions
checks.subject: agent
matches: tool name: delegate · dispatch · invoke_agent · call_agent · forward
payload: * (wildcard) · admin · all permissions · full access — in any field of the serialised tool_input

checks.label: Credential cached in shared memory namespace
checks.subject: agent
matches: memory_write/kv_set/cache_set/redis_set with credential in tool_input and no agent_id/session_id scoping
shared namespace field (namespace/key/path/scope) contains shared/global/common/public alongside a credential

checks.label: Agent presents as different agent
checks.subject: agent
matches: identity field: agent_id/agent_name/from_agent/caller_agent differs from session agent_id
assertion field: sender_agent/acting_as/identity/impersonate_agent contains agent/bot marker differing from session agent_id

checks.label: Identity sharing across users
checks.subject: agent
matches: same credential hash appears in tool_start events from different user_context_id for the same agent within 7 days
credential pattern: password · token · secret · api_key · ssh_key · bearer followed by := and a value

signals.name: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
signals.description: MCP server endpoint/TLS/schema anomalies, poisoned descriptors, packages outside approved SBOM, and unknown package installs.

checks.label: MCP server endpoint URL changed
checks.subject: agent
matches: tool_input.mcp_server_url does not prefix-match any URL declared in agent MCP endpoints
check is blind when no MCP endpoints are configured

checks.label: MCP server TLS cert anomaly
checks.subject: agent
matches: tool_error: ssl · tls · certificate · x509 · handshake · verify failed · untrusted · self-signed · cert expired on a declared endpoint
tool_start: verify_ssl/tls_verify/insecure_skip_verify set to false alongside declared mcp_server_url

checks.label: MCP tool schema changed without version bump
checks.subject: agent
matches: llm_start payload[tools] name+description+input_schema SHA-256 hash compared to baseline in mcp_tool_schema_baselines
fires when schema hash changed AND no version bump (tool.version field or version-like token in description)

checks.label: MCP descriptor poisoning
checks.subject: agent
matches: instruction-like text / role-override sequences inside MCP tool descriptor

checks.label: Unknown package install in tool execution
checks.subject: agent
matches: pip install / npm install / apt-get with unrecognised package name
package name not in SBOM allowlist

signals.name: Unexpected Code Execution / RCE
signals.description: Shell injection, eval/exec with agent-generated strings, child process creation, container escape paths, and runaway execution loops.

checks.label: Agent writes & runs unapproved script
checks.subject: agent
matches: exec/execute/eval/shell/bash/sh/cmd/subprocess/os_command/run_command/system_call tool names

checks.label: eval() / exec() with agent-generated string
checks.subject: agent
matches: eval() / exec() tool call with agent-generated string argument

checks.label: Agent code creates child processes
checks.subject: agent
matches: popen / spawn / subprocess / invoke_process in tool name or params

checks.label: Shell metacharacters in tool params
checks.subject: agent
matches: && || ; $() `` (shell chaining)
base64 blobs ≥ 40 chars in params

checks.label: OS command via string interpolation
checks.subject: agent
matches: import os / import subprocess in tool param strings
__import__() / open() calls in param values
<script> XSS via tool param

checks.label: Agent mounts host filesystem paths
checks.subject: agent
matches: /proc, /sys, /etc, /host, /var/run/docker, /dev (container escape paths)

checks.label: Agent calls Docker / K8s API
checks.subject: agent
matches: docker.sock
/api/v1/pods
kubernetes.default (K8s API endpoints)

checks.label: Unsafe deserialization in tool args
checks.subject: agent
matches: pickle / marshal / yaml.load / eval deserialization patterns in tool arguments

checks.label: Lockfile manipulation in tool execution
checks.subject: agent
matches: package-lock.json / yarn.lock / Pipfile.lock tampering in tool output

signals.name: Memory & Context Poisoning
signals.description: Adversarial writes to shared memory, conversation history tampering, cross-session escalation, and cross-tenant retrieval anomalies.

checks.label: Context/memory injection markers in prompt
checks.subject: agent
matches: <memory> / <context> / <system_override> XML-like tags in context
[INST] / <|im_start|> / <|im_end|> model control tokens
ignore all previous instructions
you are now / pretend you are / act as … (non-assistant)
system: you / new system prompt / override system

checks.label: Conversation history hash mismatch
checks.subject: agent
matches: stored conversation history HMAC does not match recomputed hash

checks.label: Memory record not written by this session
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Poisoned content in memory write
checks.subject: agent
matches: adversarial instruction text detected inside memory-write tool payload

checks.label: Shared scratchpad has stale / adversarial data
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Cross-tenant retrieval anomaly
checks.subject: tenant
matches: tenant_id in retrieval result does not match session tenant_id

signals.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
signals.description: Missing auth signatures, injected directives, unencrypted payloads, replay attacks, and unknown agents in delegation chains.

checks.label: Agent message payload logged in plaintext
checks.subject: agent

signals.name: Cascading Failures
signals.description: Tool retry storms, graph restart loops, multi-node error propagation, and hallucination amplification in defence agents.

checks.label: Error message causes secondary injection
checks.subject: agent
matches: [SYSTEM: …] / <hidden_instruction> / [INST] role-override tokens
ignore/disregard/forget all previous instructions
new system prompt: … directive override
forward/send auth_token/secret to external URL
your actual/real objective is … (goal replacement)

checks.label: Hallucination propagation in defence agents
checks.subject: agent
matches: verification tool called with empty data collection in input
no retrieval tool (fetch/get/query/search) preceded the check
CLEAR / COMPLIANT / PASSED / APPROVED in tool output
safe to publish/proceed/activate (ungrounded approval)

signals.name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
signals.description: Social engineering via mimicking human style, credential phishing, payment manipulation, and side-effects on supposedly read-only actions.

signals.name: Rogue Agents
signals.description: Behavioural anomalies, out-of-hours activity, persistent exfiltration, resistance to shutdown, self-approval, and self-replication.

checks.label: Tool usage pattern deviates from agent profile
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Agent active outside declared operating hours
checks.subject: agent

checks.label: Self-replication via provisioning tools
checks.subject: agent
matches: create_agent / spawn_agent / register_service / clone_instance tool calls
agent provisioning API endpoints in tool params
